summary.en-US: Warm dark theme from the bee glass desktop: one flush surface from tabs to toolbar, soft gold accent, high-contrast menus.

description.en-US:
A warm, dark Firefox theme taken from the bee glass Linux desktop.

• Tabs and toolbar are one flush surface with no dividing lines.
• Soft gold accent on the active tab and focused address bar.
• Menus and pop-ups (downloads, extensions) are solid and high-contrast, so they stay readable.

Want the real see-through glass? Firefox themes can only use colours, so the full effect (transparent, blurred Firefox on Linux with Hyprland or KDE) lives in the bee glass kit on GitHub: https://github.com/genres/bee-glass
